g.text: GALINI / L03 / radius-aware route witness corrections
GA-L02-SP2 / corrected centers stay inside the existing spaces; no new route or body change
Dashed rose: L02 witness. Solid teal and radius-.30 disks: L03 witness. Existing floor topology and shell openings are retained. Local projected capsule/finite-shell checks
accompany these drawings; they cannot prove tread collision, guards, headroom or continuous native movement.
